title: Populate bike catalog with Yamaha R15, KTM Duke 390, and Royal Enfield Classic 350 data

requirements.text: Seed the backend with the following three bikes if the catalog is empty: (1) Yamaha R15 — price ₹1,80,000, engine 155cc, mileage 40 km/l, image https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1609630875171-b1321377ee65; (2) KTM Duke 390 — price ₹3,10,000, engine 373cc, mileage 28 km/l, image https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1617814076668-7d9f5bff031f; (3) Royal Enfield Classic 350 — price ₹1,95,000, engine 349cc, mileage 35 km/l, image https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1597008858255-6c1b16ef5b24.
acceptanceCriteria: On first deploy, the backend stable map contains exactly the three specified bikes.
Each bike record includes name, price, engine, mileage, and image URL fields.
Calling the getAllBikes function returns all three bikes.

requirements.text: Ensure the catalog page and bike cards display the engine capacity (e.g., '155cc') and mileage (e.g., '40 km/l') fields alongside price for each bike, using the data fetched from the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Each bike card on the catalog page shows the engine and mileage values.
The bike detail page also displays engine and mileage in the specs section.
Values match what is stored in the backend (e.g., ₹1,80,000, 155cc, 40 km/l for Yamaha R15).

requirements.text: Display the Unsplash image URLs provided for each bike as the bike photo in both the catalog card and detail page. Use the exact URLs: Yamaha R15 → https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1609630875171-b1321377ee65, KTM Duke 390 → https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1617814076668-7d9f5bff031f, Royal Enfield Classic 350 → https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1597008858255-6c1b16ef5b24.
acceptanceCriteria: BikeCard renders the bike's image URL from backend data as the card photo.
BikeDetailPage renders the same image URL in the photo carousel.
No placeholder image is shown when a valid image URL is present.

constraints: Do not introduce an Express.js or Node.js backend — all data must be stored and served from the existing Motoko backend actor.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Adding new bikes beyond the three specified.
Implementing an admin UI to add bikes via a form at this stage.
Changing the overall visual theme or layout.
